description: This file defines the RedirectMiddleware class, which implements HTTP request redirect handling as middleware in the GuzzleHttp client library. It includes logic for following redirects, tracking redirect history, limiting maximum redirects, and modifying requests accordingly.

classes.name: RedirectMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling HTTP redirects in GuzzleHttp, with support for maximum redirects, redirect headers, request modification, and redirect history tracking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware handler that manages redirect logic based on options.

methods.name: checkRedirect
methods.description: Checks if the response requires a redirect and handles the redirect if necessary.

methods.name: withTracking
methods.description: Enables redirect history tracking by modifying headers on promise resolution.

methods.name: guardMax
methods.description: Checks and enforces the maximum number of redirects.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request for redirection, including setting methods, URIs, and headers.

methods.name: redirectUri
methods.description: Resolves and validates the redirect URI based on the Location header and allowed protocols.
